en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 7. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, and from Muḥammad ibn ‘Abdil Ḥamīd, from Yūnus ibn Ya’qūb, from Um Sa’īd Al-Aḥmasiyyah, who said:

I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)), “What do you say is the reward for the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.)?” Imam (a.s.) replied, “O Um Sa’īd! We say that it is equal to the reward of a Hajj and an ‘Umrah, and there is this much reward in it.” Um Sa’īd added that the Imam (a.s.) stretched open his arms with his fingers bent.
